newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: KTM revs higher on buoyant earnings.
newsitem.headline: KTM revs higher on buoyant earnings.

text.p: Austrian motorcycle maker KTM was the top gainer in an overall weaker Vienna market on Tuesday after the company reported robust first half earnings and an upbeat forecast for the full year.
At 0938 GMT, KTM was 2.65 percent, or 19 schillings higher at 735 while the ATX index was down 0.57 percent.
"The stock's been doing nothing for a while and then we had those good earnings figures which confirmed the firm's growth potential," a trader said.
On Monday, KTM posted a 12 percent rise in pretax profit to 57 million schillings for the first half of the year and said the second half had got off to a good start due to high orders and delivery.

Speculation that KTM is planning a listing in New York was also a buying incentive, the trader added. A KTM spokesman told Reuters the company had been considering a listing, but that no timeframe nor possible size of the listing had yet been fixed.
"No details whatsoever have been fixed," he said.
KTM, the stock exchange's youngest stock, has outperformed the market since it was listed on December 12 last year at 590 schillings.
